The Process

How It Works

Five simple steps to the most exciting meal of your month.

01
📲
Order on WhatsApp

Message us before the monthly cutoff. Choose your box size. That's it.

02
🌍
We Pick the Country

We secretly select a destination and curate an authentic meal from its cuisine.

03
👨‍🍳
We Prepare & Pack

Fresh, authentic ingredients. Packaged beautifully. Country still a secret.

04
📦
Collect on 1st Friday

Pick up from Lynnwood or Hatfield. Sealed tight. No spoilers.

05
🍽️
Find Out As You Eat!

Open it. Smell it. Taste it. Your passport gets stamped only at first bite.

Got Questions?

We've Got Answers 💡

Simply send us a WhatsApp message on 079 499 8013. Tell us which box size you want and we'll confirm your order. It's that easy!
Orders close 7 days before the first Friday of each month. This gives us time to prepare everything perfectly. Don't miss it!
We have collection points in Lynnwood and Hatfield, Pretoria. Once you've ordered, we'll confirm your pickup location and time.
Absolutely not! The country is kept completely secret right up until you open your box at home. That's the whole experience — the mystery is the meal.
Let us know when ordering! We'll do our best to accommodate dietary preferences and allergies. Just mention it in your WhatsApp message.
Solo box (serves 1): R200 · Duo box (serves 2): R380 · Family box (serves 4): R700. Payment is confirmed before collection.
Never. Every month is a brand new destination. We have the whole world to explore — we're just getting started.
